about: A statechart hands the algorithms records whose `status` field is a value of an enum, and a value of the enum itself, and holds what they give back: a list of those records with one item's status set (SetStatus, its status taken from the payload of the event), how many items stand at a status named by its variant (CountStatus), and the status of one item (StatusOf), held in a variable of the enum and compared with a variant in a guard. Each value crosses by the name its variant is declared with: `in_progress` is spelled with an underscore and the declared values (2, 5, 7) are not the variants' positions, so a value that crossed by its position or by a backend's own spelling would not read back as written. Expected values are derived from the document, not observed from a backend.

steps.note: three items come in, each with the status its payload names
the algorithm counts the items whose enum field is the variant the statechart names
item 1 is open, so the guard on what StatusOf returns is false
item 1 moves to done: the payload's enum field is handed to SetStatus, the list comes back with that item's field set, and StatusOf answers the status it now has
the value StatusOf returns compares equal to the variant in the guard
no item has id 9: the list comes back as it went in, and StatusOf answers the variant its body starts at
the variant spelled with an underscore crosses both ways as written
a fifth item does not fit the four the list holds: nothing is appended, and error.execution says so
a full list is handed over and comes back whole, with the one item's status set
